title: Recipe 11: Delegated access with user consent
titleZh: 方案11：经用户同意的委托访问
summary: A signed-in user chooses an agent, scopes, and lifetime. The server returns a short-lived token once; expiry and revocation fail before any business handler.
summaryZh: 已登录用户选择 Agent、能力范围与有效期。服务端只返回一次短期凭证；过期或撤销后，请求会在业务函数之前失败。

files.label: App.vue
files.role: Consent UI, records, and invoke checks
files.roleZh: 授权界面、记录与调用检查

files.label: server.mjs
files.role: Delegation issue, inspect, invoke, and revoke
files.roleZh: 委托签发、内省、调用与撤销

guide.title: Consent narrows authority before a token exists
guide.titleZh: 先收窄授权，再签发凭证
intro: The browser session remains separate from the delegated credential. The page displays the token once only because this is an inspection fixture.
Issue a two-minute read-only delegation, invoke it, revoke it, and invoke again. The second call must fail before invoice data is read.
introZh: 浏览器会话与委托凭证保持分离。只有为了便于检查，示例才在页面上显示一次原始凭证。
签发一份两分钟的只读委托，调用后撤销，再次调用。第二次请求必须在读取发票数据之前失败。

steps.title: Record the user's choices
steps.body: Agent name, scopes, and TTL are explicit inputs. The token is not part of page state.
steps.bodyZh: Agent 名称、范围和有效期都是显式输入；凭证不进入页面状态。

steps.title: Issue through one page action
steps.titleZh: 通过一个页面动作签发
steps.body: The action calls the backend after checking sign-in and at least one scope.
steps.bodyZh: 动作先检查登录状态与至少一个范围，再调用后端。

steps.title: Reject after revocation
steps.body: The backend stores a hash, checks scope on invoke, and rejects revoked credentials before the handler.
steps.bodyZh: 后端保存哈希，在调用时检查范围，并在业务函数前拒绝已撤销凭证。

guide.note: Sign in with demo@example.com / pling-demo. The raw token is shown once for inspection; a production client keeps it outside page state and model context.
guide.noteZh: 账号为 demo@example.com / pling-demo。原始凭证只显示一次供检查；生产客户端应让它远离页面状态与模型上下文。
